# clean-app fixture

Data-flow fixture for `define` and `flows` (docs/05-data-flow.md, F4): UIKit
built in code and SwiftUI, MVVM + Clean, Alamofire with `async`/`await`,
UserDefaults, a Keychain wrapper declared in `swiftgraph.json`, a file cache,
Swinject, Combine `@Published` + `sink`, a `UITableViewCell` and a SwiftUI row
in a `List`, and a profile screen split into components and extensions across
files (SwiftUI `ProfileView`, UIKit `ProfileViewController`). It is never compiled; expected answers are in
`test/expected/clean-app.*`.
